_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 77: 12-13 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is about the drones he saw when they were praying on the 4th of July, that the drones he is seeing are not like the ones bought off Amazon, that these are military drones smuggled in from Iran, and that they are more sophisticated.
mentions.quote: These are drones smuggled in from like from Iran
mentions.falsify_match: Military-grade drones of Iranian origin found inside America.
mentions.falsify_miss: Consumer drones, or no drones at all. Note that this directly reverses the earlier telling, which had them bought online.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is seeing an attack in America with sophisticated drones, that it is a planned staged attack on multiple fronts trying to derail the 2028 election, that they are more focused on the midterm and feel they have it but it is about flipping the presidency too, and that he sees a divide trying to make him a martyr.
mentions.quote: multiple fronts trying to derail the 2020 2028 election
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated drone attack in America timed against an election.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack in either cycle. Martyr is left undefined, so a death, an injury or a political reversal could each be read into it.

mentions.claim_text: He says their voices became one voice praying for the nation and there is no distance in prayer, then says he saw a new pipeline with the Kurds and a rising of Iraq's economy as Iran was defeated and greatly wounded, that he heard they would be taken back to the stone age in a majority of areas though not the whole nation, that the hand that was in Iraq was removed, and that he saw Iraq rise with oil wealth, Saudi Arabia, Rolls-Royces and cars for the Iraqi people, with much corruption still remaining.
mentions.quote: rising of Iraq's economy as Iran was being defeated
mentions.falsify_match: Iraqi oil wealth rising while Iranian infrastructure is destroyed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None on a date, since none is given. The hedges are built in: a majority of areas rather than the nation, and corruption remaining, so partial outcomes read as hits.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a void concerning the Save America Act and was told to speak to it, that the Lord said it needs support structure and he saw steel beams supporting a sphere, that if the whole thing cannot pass they should get support systems outside of it because those can be passed, that it had three major parts that could be split off and passed because they had the votes the whole did not, that he does not know what those are, and that the Lord said to focus on this and not waste the time.
mentions.quote: three major parts of a splitting off of the Save America Act
mentions.falsify_match: Three provisions split out of the bill and passed separately.
mentions.falsify_miss: The bill passes whole, or nothing is split off. He states plainly that he does not know what the three parts are, which leaves nothing to check until something passes and can be counted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a big nothing burger and a big hot air balloon, that the promises to make America great again came to nothing, that it was a ballroom and the president stood on the steps looking out with less than two years left wondering what to do now, and asks whether this is 2027 when he will have the ballroom.
mentions.quote: I saw a big nothing burger, a big hot air balloon
mentions.falsify_match: A visibly stalled second half of the term, with the ballroom finished in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: Substantive legislative wins through 2027. Came to nothing has no threshold, and he asks rather than states whether the scene is 2027, so the date is a guess of his own.

mentions.claim_text: He says he cares about awakening unto God and revival, that the Lord said he is calling one last call and one major push for a harvest of souls, that he has said a thousand times including in 2024 that Trump will not save America, and that the only thing that will save America is an awakening unto God.
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as stated: no measure of an awakening and no time given.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Worth noting it is consistent with the record: he has said this since 2024, and it is the line that lets a disappointing presidency sit beside the claims made for it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is bothered, that he prayed more hours over the 2024 term and the president's safety from the bullet than anything and thought surely, and that the Lord answered that he holds the church accountable and asked how they pray, quoting if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, that a window does not last long and a door is bigger, and that it is not about the next two years but about getting him to the midterms because once he loses the Senate or the House his term is over for passing anything and he will be a stalemate presidency.
mentions.quote: I hold the church accountable. How do you pray for your Trump?
mentions.condition_text: if the church humbles itself and prays
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable by design: any outcome is the church's response to the window.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. This is the load-bearing move in the whole corpus stated outright. Responsibility for the outcome is transferred to the audience before the outcome is known, so a failed forecast becomes a failure to pray.

mentions.claim_text: He declares in prayer that God gives power to get wealth and establishes his covenant, that they call those things that be not as though they were, that Satan must let go of the money, and calls it in from the north, south, east and west for a bus project, seeing buses and new transportation with air conditioning.
mentions.quote: we call those things that be not as though they were right now
mentions.falsify_match: The ministry acquiring buses with air conditioning.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. This is one of the few declarations in the corpus with a physical object attached, so it can actually be checked against the ministry's own assets.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a recording, establishing that the Lord gave it in December rather than March, that it is dated December 29th of 2025, and confirms that he actually saw it on December 28th when the Lord spoke to them.
mentions.quote: You actually saw it December 28th though
mentions.falsify_match: The recording exists and carries the stated date.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date does not match. Nothing is claimed here, but the dating matters: it is what any later fulfilment assertion about this word rests on, and it is checkable against the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord kept showing him unbelievable darkness over America and that he heard New York has been weighed in the balance and found lacking concerning this man, referring to the incoming mayor, that a shaking is coming, and that he saw Italy and the mafia, the five families rising up against him in the days ahead, then presents a news story about Little Italy and immigration as the beginning of what the Lord showed them in January.
mentions.quote: I saw Italy, I saw mafia, the five families rising up against him
mentions.falsify_match: Organised crime figures moving against the New York mayor.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The fulfilment offered is a news story about neighbourhood groups objecting to immigration policy, which is a long way from five mafia families rising up, and the gap between the two is the point.

mentions.claim_text: He says China wants a warning system for dangerous asteroids and that they already have one, that he told them he saw one coming in and could say where it was in the sky, that God gave him its actual name which was mathematical with letters in it, that he is not educated enough to know what he is seeing, and that it is headed here, the Lord said they will not stop it, and it will penetrate and come through and hit the earth.
mentions.quote: it will actually penetrate. It will come through and hit the earth
mentions.falsify_miss: No impact, but no date is given here. He says God gave him the actual name and then does not say it, which withholds the one detail that would make this checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a plan to nudge an asteroid by striking it like NASA's DART mission with a test planned for 2027, and says that is probably the one the Lord showed him that will actually hit in 2027 next year because it is getting close and it was a massive rock.
mentions.quote: that will actually hit 2027 next year because it's getting close
mentions.falsify_match: An asteroid striking the earth in 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No impact in 2027. The date does not come from the vision: he takes it from a news item about a deflection test and attaches his rock to it, marking it probably. A test being scheduled is not an object being on course.
